messages.content: Write a short review, about 60 words, of a homestay we stayed at in Coorg, for their guest book.

Thank you, Ponnappa family, for a wonderful three days! Waking up to mist over the coffee plantation was magical, and the food was the best part of our trip. We will dream about your bamboo shoot curry and homemade jam. The children loved feeding the ducks. We felt like guests in a family home, not a hotel.
With thanks, the Menons
Write a notice, about 60 words, for the school notice board announcing an inter-house quiz competition.

NOTICE: Inter-House Quiz Competition
An inter-house quiz will be held on Friday, 12 July, at 11 am in the school auditorium. Each house must send a team of three students from Classes 8 to 10. Topics include science, history, sports and general knowledge. Names must be given to the house captains by Tuesday. Come and cheer for your house!
- Quiz Club
I'm recommending Frankenstein to my book club. Write a short pitch, about 70 words, without big spoilers.

Frankenstein by Mary Shelley is much more than a monster story. A young scientist, Victor Frankenstein, discovers how to give life to a body he builds himself, but he is horrified by what he has made and runs away. The creature, left alone, must learn about the world by himself. The book asks big questions about loneliness, responsibility and what makes us human. It is dark, thoughtful and surprisingly moving.
Write a short story for kids, about 85 words, about a girl who bakes a cake for her mother's birthday but it sinks in the middle.

Kavya wanted to surprise her mother with a cake. She mixed the flour, sugar and eggs carefully and put the cake in the oven. But when she took it out, the middle had sunk into a deep hole. Kavya's eyes filled with tears. Then she had an idea. She filled the hole with whipped cream and strawberries. When her mother came home, she gasped. "What a special cake!" she said, and hugged her. Kavya learnt that mistakes can sometimes make things even sweeter.
Remind my friend Kritika to bring her costume to rehearsal on Wednesday. About 35 words, light and friendly. I'm Aditi.

Hi Kritika,
Just a little reminder that rehearsal is on Wednesday. Please do not forget your costume! Without it, you will have to go on stage in your school uniform. See you there!
Aditi
Our colony is holding a Christmas carol evening. Could you draft the invitation, about 55 words? Friday, 7 pm, near the clock tower. Sign it The Colony Choir.

Dear Neighbours,
Come and sing with us at our Christmas Carol Evening this Friday at 7 pm near the clock tower. Bring your voices and your family, and join us for plenty of joyful music. Everyone is welcome, whether you can sing well or not. Let us fill the lane with cheer!
The Colony Choir
Write a story, about 90 words, about a boy whose kite string snaps, and a stranger helps him get the kite back. End with the boy thanking him.

Imran's kite soared high above the rooftops until the string snapped. The kite floated away and caught on a tall tree near the market. Imran stood below, sad and helpless. A stranger carrying a bag of vegetables stopped and looked up. He put down his bag, found a long bamboo pole from a nearby shop and gently lifted the kite from the branches. Imran took it with both hands. "Thank you so much!" he said, grinning. The stranger smiled and went on his way.
A taxi driver took a very long route and charged me far more than I expected. Write a polite complaint, about 60 words, to the taxi company.

Dear Sir or Madam,
I took a taxi from your company, and the driver took a very long route to my destination. As a result, the fare was far more than I had expected. I would like to request you to look into this and explain how the fare was calculated. I look forward to your response.
Yours faithfully
Tell a story, about 100 words, about a rickshaw puller who finds a bag left behind by a passenger and returns it. End with the passenger thanking him warmly.

Raju pulled his rickshaw through the busy streets all day. One evening he noticed a bag on the back seat, left behind by his last passenger. He looked inside and saw only clothes and papers. He did not know the passenger's name, so he went back to the stand where he had picked him up and waited. An hour later, the worried passenger came running. Raju held up the bag. The man smiled with relief and thanked him again and again. "You are an honest man," he said.
Please write a paragraph of about 80 words on why teamwork matters, for a school essay.

Teamwork matters because no one can do everything alone. When people work together, each person brings a different skill, and the work becomes easier and better. In a football match, a goal is scored by the whole team, not by one player. At school, group projects teach us to listen, share ideas and help one another. Teamwork also builds trust, because we learn that others will support us. A good team also celebrates success together, which makes every victory sweeter.
My neighbour parks his scooter in front of our gate every morning. Write a polite note asking him to move it, about 50 words. I'm Mrs. Iyer from Flat 6.

Dear Neighbour,
I am Mrs. Iyer from Flat 6. I have noticed that your scooter is parked in front of our gate every morning, and it makes it difficult for us to get out. Could you kindly park it somewhere else? Thank you so much for understanding.
Mrs. Iyer
Describe a cat sleeping on a window ledge, about 50 words.

The cat lies curled on the window ledge, a soft grey ball in a patch of sunshine. Her chest rises and falls slowly. Her tail wraps around her paws, and one ear twitches at a sound outside. She is warm and completely at peace. The whole afternoon seems to slow down just to let her sleep.
Write a four-line poem about the waves of the sea, about 25 words.

The waves come rolling to the shore,
They whisper, tumble, and then roar.
They wash the sand and run away,
And come again another day.
Write a polite request, about 55 words, to my dance teacher to move my sister's Saturday class to the evening because she has a school event that morning. I'm Ananya.

Dear Madam,
My sister has a school event on Saturday morning, so she cannot attend her usual dance class. Could you please move her class to the evening that day? She does not want to miss it. I would be very grateful for your help. Thank you for your understanding.
Ananya
We were charged for a dish we did not order at a restaurant. Write a complaint to the manager, about 65 words, asking for the bill to be corrected. I'm Mr. Gupta.

Dear Manager,
We dined at your restaurant, and I found that our bill included a dish we did not order. I request you to please check the bill and correct it. I am sure it was an honest mistake. I would appreciate it if you could resolve this soon. Thank you for your help.
Yours sincerely,
Mr. Gupta
Invite my friends on a day trek to a nearby hill on Sunday. We start at 6 am from the bus stand. Write the message, about 45 words. I'm Imran.

Hey friends,
Let's go on a day trek to the nearby hill this Sunday! We will start at 6 am from the bus stand, so please be on time. It will be a great way to enjoy the fresh air together. Tell me if you're in!
Imran
Explain in one paragraph of around 55 words why playing a team game teaches us to share.

Playing a team game teaches us to share. A player who keeps the ball alone rarely wins, so we learn to pass it to someone better placed. We cheer for our teammates, and we accept that everyone has a turn. The joy of a shared goal is greater than the joy of a single player.
Polite complaint to a courier company: my parcel arrived two weeks late and the box was dented, and I want an explanation and an apology. 40 words, signed Lars.

Dear Courier Company,
My parcel arrived two weeks late, and the box was dented. I would like an explanation, and I would also like an apology for the delay and the damage. Please reply to me soon. Thank you.
Lars
A water-saving notice for the hostel, 40 words: close taps tightly, report leaks to the warden, turn off the tap while brushing teeth, and take short showers. Thank the students at the end.

NOTICE
Please save water in the hostel. Close the taps tightly after use, turn off the tap while brushing your teeth, and take short showers. Report any leaks to the warden at once. Thank you, students, for helping us.
A rhyme, six lines, about a red balloon slipping from a hand and floating away, 45 words.

The balloon slipped out of my hand,
And floated high above the land.
It rose up, red against the sky,
And waved to me as it went by.
It grew so small I could not see,
And that was how it said goodbye to me.
